Millal ja kus jazz tekkis?: When and where did jazz emerge?
19. sajandi lõpus ja 20. sajandi alguses: In the late 19th and early 20th century in the USA, above all in New Orleans.
Millal ja kus tekkis sõna „jazz\"?: When and where did the word “jazz” appear?
Name the four key features of jazz.
Improvisatsioon, kõlavärv ehk tämber, pi: Improvisation, tone colour (timbre), instrumental line-ups, and rhythm, melody and harmony.
Mida andsid jazzile Aafrika, Euroopa ja: What did Africa, Europe and the Caribbean contribute to jazz?
Aafrika: kollektiivne muusika loomine, i: Africa: making music collectively, improvisation, call and response. Europe: harmony and instruments. The Caribbean: rhythm-based dance music and more complex rhythms.
New Orleansi väljak, kus nädalavahetuste: A square in New Orleans where people played music, danced and kept their cultural heritage alive at weekends.

Scott Joplin (1868–1917). Näiteks „Maple: Scott Joplin (1868–1917). For example “Maple Leaf Rag” and “The Entertainer”.
Mis on bluusi struktuur ja millest see p: What is the structure of the blues and what was it based on?
12-taktiline. Põhines töölauludel ja spi: 12 bars. It was based on work songs and spirituals.
Bessie Smith, Muddy Waters, B.B. King.
Pillimehed mängivad samal ajal, aga igaü: The players all play at the same time, but each one improvises independently.
Kus mängisid New Orleansi harrastusorkes: Where did the New Orleans amateur bands play?
In the entertainment venues of the Storyville district. There were nearly 30 bands.
Millistel löökidel on New Orleansi jazzi: Which beats are accented in New Orleans jazz?
1. ja 3. löögil (marsilik pulss). Off-be: Beats 1 and 3 (a march-like pulse). There's no off-beat, i.e. no accent on beats 2 and 4.
Nimeta meloodiagrupi ja rütmigrupi pilli: Name the instruments of the front line and the rhythm section.
Meloodia: kornet või trompet, tromboon,: Front line: cornet or trumpet, trombone, clarinet. Rhythm section: tuba, banjo, drums.
Mis asendas tuuba ja bandžo ning mis lis: What replaced the tuba and banjo, and what was added?
Tuuba asendus kontrabassiga, bandžo kita: The tuba was replaced by the double bass, the banjo by the guitar, and the piano was added.
Marsi- või kirikumeloodia, ragtime'i pal: A march or church melody, a ragtime piece or a 12-bar blues.
Kes juhtis King Oliver's Creole Jazz Ban: Who led King Oliver's Creole Jazz Band?
Joe „King\" Oliver, kornetist-trompetist: Joe “King” Oliver, cornet and trumpet player.
Millise ansambliga tegi Jelly Roll Morto: Which band did Jelly Roll Morton make recordings with?
Miks New Orleansi jazzi õitseaeg 1917. a: Why did the heyday of New Orleans jazz end in 1917?
Storyville suleti ja muusikud läksid Chi: Storyville was closed and the musicians moved to Chicago.
Mida uut tõi jazzi Louis Armstrong?: What did Louis Armstrong bring to jazz?
Jazzist sai solistide muusika. Ta võttis: Jazz became soloists' music. He brought in chords and written notation, and introduced blue notes and scat singing.
Sõnadeta, silpidega improviseeritud laul: Improvised singing with syllables instead of words.
Kelle tsitaat on „Ilma Armstrongita pole: Who said “Without Armstrong there would be no jazz…”?
Bandleader and drummer Papa Jack Laine.
Kes tegi esimese jazzisalvestuse ja mill: Who made the first jazz recording, and when?
Original Dixieland Jazz Band Nick LaRocc: The Original Dixieland Jazz Band, led by Nick LaRocca, in 1917. The record sold over a million copies.
Kuidas erines dixielandi kõla New Orlean: How was the Dixieland sound different from New Orleans jazz?
Väiksem kõlajõud, parem tehnika, kiirem: Less powerful sound, better technique, faster music, smoother melody, less intense tone colours. The typical sound came from a solo instrument. The line-up stayed the same.
Swing and big bands in the early 1930s. Dixieland came back in the late 1940s.
Mis oli Chicago jazzi peamine muutus imp: What was the main change in improvisation in Chicago jazz?
Kollektiivne improvisatsioon asendus sol: Collective improvisation gave way to solo improvisation.
Hetk, kui orkester vaikib ja solist impr: The moment when the band goes silent and the soloist improvises.
Mis oli Austin High School Gang?: What was the Austin High School Gang?
Valgete keskkoolinoorte ansambel, noorte: A band of white high-school students, a breeding ground for young talent and the Chicago style.

Mida uut tõi Fletcher Henderson?: What did Fletcher Henderson bring that was new?
Jagas orkestri pilligruppideks, lõi tämb: He split the band into sections, created a new band style by contrasting timbres, and worked out the principles of arranging for a large band.
Kes juhtis kõige populaarsemat tantsuork: Who led the most popular dance band, and who played in it?
Paul Whiteman. Seal mängisid kornetist B: Paul Whiteman. Cornet player Bix Beiderbecke and guitarist Eddie Lang played in it.

New Yorgis, Harlemi Cotton Clubis. Džung: In New York, at the Cotton Club in Harlem. Jungle style means expressive sounds from the trumpet and trombone.
